notes.title: Full game update (7/22/2022)
notes.content:
World’s End Club update announcement (7/22/2022)

[b]Update details[/b]
・Fixed fix the issue in the Yamaguchi level where Chuko’s ability was not melting the ice under certain conditions.

For the best possible experience, please make sure to update your game.

If you encounter any issues with the game, please kindly get in touch via Steam Community or send a message to our customer support!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1570020/discussions/]World's End Club Community[/url]

[url=https://izanagigames.co.jp/en/contact]IzanagiGames Customer Support[/url]

notes.title: Update Released
notes.content:
Hello,

The issues that some users were experiencing on specific PC environments have now been fixed and we have released an update.

Thank you for your patience and for your feedback.
We kindly ask that players update their game.

Thanks!

-IzanagiGames
